rai...@my-dejanews.com wrote: > I have a question about FD. > > Fire Dance [SAB] - action *Fire Dance's target vampire is chosen when the > action is announced.[RTR 970425]
*Is directed or not based on the > controller of the target, as always > > Could some one give me a example of how this could be directed > and non directed. A directed action is one that targets one other Methuselah and/or any card(s)/counter(s) she controls. An undirected action does not (or targets more than one Methuselah). If the Sabbat vampire selected as the target of the Fire Dance is controlled by another Methuselah, the action is directed. If the Sabbat vampire selected as the target is one that you control, the action is undirected. -- L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com) VTES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
